footnotes: a The concentration of rapamycin in the synergy antifungal screening experiment was 0.008 μM, at which rapamycin does not show antifungal activity. As MIC alone for compounds 1 and 2 > 100 μM, we used 100 to calculate FICI, and the start concentration was 25 μM in the checkerboard assay, and the possible minimal FICI was shown. b S: synergism; NS: no synergism.
